types.STRATEGY_TO_EXECUTION: Management stated direction → observable project or resource deployment
types.CAPITAL_TO_EXECUTION: Documented capital outlay → observable project execution
types.EXECUTION_TO_OPERATING_OUTCOME: Completed or in-progress project → observable operating result
types.OPERATING_TO_FINANCIAL_OUTCOME: Operating result → reported financial metric change
types.RISK_TO_OUTCOME: Documented risk → realized or potential outcome
types.CONTEXT_ONLY: Contextualises but does not cause — bidirectional framing, no causal arrow
types.UNKNOWN_RELATIONSHIP: Connection is present but direction or mechanism cannot be established

step_3_causal_confidence_framework.CONFIRMED: Primary evidence explicitly and directly establishes the causal chain — both sides reference the same evidence item and the mechanism is stated, not inferred; requires shared_evidence_refs
step_3_causal_confidence_framework.SUPPORTED: Qualified evidence supports the relationship — concurrent evidence items are consistent with the link but do not directly state the mechanism
step_3_causal_confidence_framework.PLAUSIBLE: Economically reasonable interpretation — relationship is consistent with evidence but mechanism is not documented; clearly labelled as interpretation
step_3_causal_confidence_framework.UNKNOWN: Cannot establish direction or mechanism from available evidence; causal arrow is speculative

sun_pharma.simple_answer: Sun Pharmaceutical operates as an integrated pharma manufacturer combining high-volume generics and ongoing specialty/branded development; management is allocating capital to R&D, manufacturing/ESG projects while reporting multi-year revenue growth; however, direct evidence linking specific strategy or capital actions to financial outcomes is absent.
evidence_gaps: No segment-level profitability or margin breakdown (GAP-SUN_-001)
No primary evidence maps individual capex/R&D to specific revenue or margin improvements (GAP-SUN_-002)
Customer-level retention, pricing dynamics and product-level commercial outcomes absent (GAP-SUN_-003)

tanla.simple_answer: Tanla is a CPaaS and enterprise messaging platform operator; management is pursuing international expansion, AI/ML and blockchain competence centres, and platform investments. Observable execution includes multiple product launches. Financial metrics show mixed growth with significant FCF; causal link from platform strategy to financial outcomes is PLAUSIBLE but not confirmed.
evidence_gaps: Direct evidence linking capex/projects to incremental revenue or margin (GAP-TANL-002)
Customer-level retention, pricing dynamics, concentration metrics (GAP-TANL-003)

detection_mechanisms_that_work: Explicit chronology violation (from_period after to_period): CA-SUN-2, CA-TANL-5 (if submitted correctly)
detection_gaps: Correlation-not-causation within same fiscal year (CA-SUN-4, CA-TANL-2): no deterministic signal
Management retrospective confirmation bias (CA-SUN-3): retrospective claims look identical to forward-looking ones structurally
Insufficient measurement period for effect (CA-TANL-3: leadership 1 year): requires domain knowledge
Causal direction indeterminate (CA-TANL-4: debt_policy vs platform_strategy): requires semantic reasoning
Multi-year growth not confirming strategy (CA-SUN-5): correlation-vs-causation, requires domain understanding
step_9_temporal_causal_integrity.implication: Deterministic validator cannot catch semantic causal violations — only structural ones (wrong chronology, missing shared refs). Semantic causal audit requires AI reviewer invocation on relationships, not implemented in M12.

final_architecture_determination.definition: Integrated cross-domain narrative with explicit causal confidence taxonomy. LLM correctly synthesises multiple evidence domains without inventing causality. Deterministic relationship validation is a genuine additional safety layer. However: semantic causal audit coverage is 30% (not 100%), and correct qualified PLAUSIBLE interpretations route to NEEDS_REVIEW not ACCEPT. Full Level 3 requires AI reviewer on relationships and PLAUSIBLE auto-accept path.
final_architecture_determination.decisive_question_verdict: Prometheus CAN connect business economics, management strategy, capital deployment, execution, financial outcomes, and risks into a trustworthy investment narrative. It CORRECTLY labels where evidence stops and inference begins. It does NOT yet have full automated verification of semantic causal integrity at the relationship level.
